stem: A crop repeatedly reaches severe wilt before each irrigation and then recovers after watering. Which strategy is strongest?
choices: Use visible wilt as the regular irrigation trigger because full recovery after watering shows the current dryback strategy is working and provides a consistent crop-based endpoint
Increase EC so plants retain more water between events and can tolerate the same severe dryback without losing turgor
Extend the dryback further so roots adapt to lower water availability and become more efficient between irrigation events
Set irrigation from measured depletion and crop response so the root zone dries appropriately without repeatedly reaching severe stress
rationale: Repeated severe wilt indicates the dryback target is too aggressive. Irrigation should use measured root-zone depletion and crop response to balance aeration with avoidance of excessive water stress.
